messages.subject: unknown error with path model
parts:
Hello All, 
I am trying to model a path model and am getting the error below.  I don't know what this is trying to tell me, and it may be something simple that I am missing.  Too many mediators or something? Model and error is below: 

model <- '
hkregr ~ female + hkprerl2 + hksxbh13 + hksxenj + atprem + rinit + yrschl + 
black + asian + otherrace + mabachdeg + magraddeg
 
hkprerl2 ~ female + rinit
hksxbh13 ~ female + rinit
hksxenj ~ female + rinit
atprem ~ female + rinit
rinit ~ female
 '
fit<-sem(model, data=data, ordered=hkregr, missing="fiml")

Error in sampl...@missing.h1[[g]]$sigma[cbind(row.idx, col.idx)] : 
  subscript out of bounds

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: unknown error with path model
parts:
On 12/06/2013 05:32 PM, Aaron Franzen wrote:

> fit<-sem(model, data=data, ordered=hkregr, missing="fiml")
>
> Error in sampl...@missing.h1[[g]]$sigma[cbind(row.idx, col.idx)] :
> subscript out of bounds

Are you using an older version of lavaan? Recent versions will throw an
error that missing="fiml" is not allowed for non-ML estimators.

If you have ordered variables, you can use missing="pairwise"

Yves.
